scripts.build: pnpm --filter enjaz-platform build && if [ -d apps/web/dist ]; then rm -rf dist && cp -R apps/web/dist dist; fi && pnpm --filter @enjaz/api exec esbuild src/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=../../api/server.cjs
scripts.test: npm test --prefix apps/web && npm test --prefix services/api
